g.text: “A 45-year-old man who spends long hours working at a desk has experienced recurrent low back pain for

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: 8 months, aggravated by prolonged sitting. Based on meridian pattern differentiation, recommend

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: acupuncture points and explain the rationale for their selection and combination.”

g.text: Eight months of recurrent pain: medical

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'
font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: Urgent if there is pain below the knee,

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: numbness or weakness of a leg, saddle

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: numbness, bladder or bowel change, fever,

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

g.text: weight loss, cancer, steroid use or trauma.

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'

text.style: font-size: 5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC'
